description: This file defines React components and helper functions for rendering accessible icons representing players 'X' and 'O' in a Tic-Tac-Toe game UI. It includes utility functions for accessible labels and styled SVG icons for each player.

methods.name: iconLabelFor
methods.description: Generates an accessible label string for a given player ('X' or 'O').

methods.name: PlayerIcon
methods.description: A React functional component that renders an SVG icon for the specified player with accessibility attributes.
